title: 1.2 Decode the Blueprint
concept: Binary tree reconstruction from Preorder + Inorder sequences
objective: Drag each room token into its blueprint slot using Pre {10,5,2,7,15,12,20} & In {2,5,7,10,12,15,20}!
controls: Drag room tokens into empty tree slots  |  Full placement auto-validates when all 7 slots are filled
start_status: Drag all 7 room tokens from the top tray into the blueprint tree slots to reconstruct the vault!
hints: The first Preorder value is always the root, and its position in Inorder splits left-subtree keys from right-subtree keys.
Apply that split recursively: for each subtree, the earliest Preorder value belonging to that side is that subtree's root.
